SELECT 
    ac.ARTregID,
    ac.art_title,
    ac.DYNASTY,
    ac.ageYears,
    ac.conserve_status,
    ar.HIST_sign,
    ar.rating_profile->>'cultural_score' AS cultural_score,
    ar.rating_profile->>'research_score' AS research_score,
    ra.risk_level,
    ra.conserve_score AS risk_conserve_score,
    CASE 
        WHEN ac.conserve_status = 'Critical' THEN 'Critical'
        WHEN ac.conserve_status = 'Poor' THEN 'High Risk'
        WHEN ra.risk_level = 'High' THEN 'High Risk'
        WHEN ra.risk_level = 'Medium' THEN 'Medium Risk'
        ELSE 'Low Risk'
    END AS risk_category
FROM ArtifactsCore ac
JOIN ArtifactRatings ar ON ac.ARTregID = ar.ART_link
JOIN RiskAssessments ra ON ac.ARTregID = ra.art_concern
WHERE ra.risk_level IN ('High', 'Medium')
   OR ac.conserve_status IN ('Critical', 'Poor')
ORDER BY 
    CASE ac.conserve_status 
        WHEN 'Critical' THEN 1 
        WHEN 'Poor' THEN 2 
        WHEN 'Fair' THEN 3 
        WHEN 'Good' THEN 4 
        WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 5 
    END,
    CASE ra.risk_level 
        WHEN 'High' THEN 1 
        WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 
        WHEN 'Low' THEN 3 
    END DESC;

-- Calculate CPI for High risk artifacts and find the highest
SELECT 
    ac."ARTregID",
    ac."art_title",
    ar."HIST_sign",
    (ar."rating_profile"->>'cultural_score')::int AS cultural_score,
    (ar."rating_profile"->>'research_score')::int AS research_score,
    ac."conserve_status",
    CASE ac."conserve_status"
        WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1
        WHEN 'Good' THEN 3
        WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5
        WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7
        WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10
    END AS conserve_val,
    ((ar."HIST_sign" + (ar."rating_profile"->>'cultural_score')::int + (ar."rating_profile"->>'research_score')::int) * (10 - CASE ac."conserve_status"
        WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1
        WHEN 'Good' THEN 3
        WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5
        WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7
        WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10
    END)) / 30.0 AS CPI
FROM "ArtifactsCore" ac
JOIN "ArtifactRatings" ar ON ac."ARTregID" = ar."ART_link"
JOIN "RiskAssessments" ra ON ac."ARTregID" = ra."art_concern"
WHERE ra."risk_level" = 'High'
ORDER BY CPI DESC
LIMIT 1;

-- Let me check if there's an artifact that has both High risk AND Critical conservation status
-- across all RiskAssessments entries (not just one per artifact)
SELECT 
    ac."ARTregID",
    ac."art_title",
    ar."HIST_sign",
    ra."risk_level",
    ac."conserve_status"
FROM "ArtifactsCore" ac
JOIN "ArtifactRatings" ar ON ac."ARTregID" = ar."ART_link"
JOIN "RiskAssessments" ra ON ac."ARTregID" = ra."art_concern"
WHERE ac."conserve_status" = 'Critical'
  AND ra."risk_level" IN ('High', 'Medium')

-- Maybe the expected result is about Dynasty Value Artifacts at risk
-- Dynasty Value Artifact = from Ming/Han/Tang AND research_score > 8
-- At risk = High or Medium risk level
SELECT 
    ac."ARTregID",
    ac."art_title",
    ac."DYNASTY",
    ar."HIST_sign",
    ra."risk_level"
FROM "ArtifactsCore" ac
JOIN "ArtifactRatings" ar ON ac."ARTregID" = ar."ART_link"
JOIN "RiskAssessments" ra ON ac."ARTregID" = ra."art_concern"
WHERE ac."DYNASTY" IN ('Ming', 'Han', 'Tang')
  AND (ar."rating_profile"->>'research_score')::int > 8
  AND ra."risk_level" IN ('High', 'Medium')
ORDER BY ar."HIST_sign" DESC;
